name: Shounen
source: Ikumi's roommate and her observer, Shounen's true name was never revealed in the game. A mysterious young male, he lacks common sense regarding boy-girl relationships which Ikumi frowns upon. As a way of cheering her up, he would make up bedtime stories, find her a plushie doll, etc. although he is a bit clumsy in doing so. During critical times however, he would show up whenever Ikumi is in mortal danger.[spoiler] It was later revealed that he is not a real human, but that of the "demon" race.[/spoiler]
